messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - GPU pool us-west-2-hotpath saturated. Autoscaler failing to create new nodes due to rate-limit errors on control plane (429). Queue length rising (~12k), customer latency and 429s increasing. Paging on-call: @evan_oncall

ev an_oncall: Ack. Oncall -- I'm looking. Pulling autoscaler/controller logs and rate-limiter traces now.

indra_sre: grabbing autoscaler logs. I see repeated 429s from rate-limiter service when hitting /v1/nodes/create. Also seeing token-bucket rejections: "no tokens available" for hotpath tier. Change flagged at 2026-03-15T04:12Z from matt_platform to rate-policy.

matt_platform: I pushed a rate-policy tweak at 04:12 to tighten cross-tenant burst for cost concerns. Didn't expect it to block autoscaler control-plane calls. Rolling back possible.

indra_sre: here's the offending snippet from the new policy (sanitized):

```
rate_policy:
  tiers:
    hotpath:
      capacity: 1000
      refill_rate: 1  # <-- too low for autoscaler bursts
      window: 1s
    standard:
      capacity: 500
      refill_rate: 5

# autoscaler control calls counted against hotpath tokens
```

evan_oncall: Ok that refill_rate=1 looks wrong. Autoscaler needs to create tens of nodes in short window; token math impossible. Mitigation plan (short):
  1) Temporarily increase hotpath refill_rate to 1200/s OR exempt autoscaler client id from bucket.
  2) Bump autoscaler max_nodes from 45 -> 80 for immediate capacity.
  3) Spin up warm-pool 20 GPUs in us-west-2-hotpath.
  4) Apply short-term throttles to non-SLA customers (apply rate-limit rule) to reduce load.
  5) Notify CS and affected customers.

matt_platform: I'm on (1) and (2). Patching rate-policy now. Command: 

```bash
# patch token-bucket rate for hotpath
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/rate-policy/patch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tiers": {"hotpath": {"refill_rate": 1200}}}'
```

deploy-bot: config-change record: rate-policy patched by matt_platform at 2026-03-15T04:18Z (cid: rp-8421).

indra_sre: Applying autoscaler bump next: 

```bash
redwoodctl autoscaler set --cluster us-west-2-hotpath --max-nodes 80
```

matt_platform: warm-pool request submitted: warm-pool-create --cluster us-west-2-hotpath --count 20. API returned job id wp-9921.

indra_sre: warm pool starting: 6/20 nodes initializing.

maya_cs: I'm drafting a short customer note: "We experienced degraded performance for some workloads in us-west-2 between 04:10-04:30 UTC due to autoscaling control-plane throttling. We're mitigating and will follow up with root cause + timeline." Sending to affected tenant list now.

evan_oncall: Monitoring key metrics: queue length, 429 rate, pod pending count. Current metrics: queue ~12k -> 4.2k after initial patches; 429 % for hotpath requests down from 22% -> 3.4%. Latency p50/p95 improving.

deploy-bot: warm pool job wp-9921: 18/20 ready. Node provisioning success events streaming.

indra_sre: Autoscaler successfully creating nodes again. No further 429s from control-plane. Node count climbing to absorb backlog.

matt_platform: I also added a temporary exception for client-id autoscaler-control to not count against hotpath bucket until we complete postmortem. Patch posted to control plane (cid: rp-exempt-992).

maya_cs: Customer notifications sent for top 5 affected accounts; support queue flagged for elevated response.

evan_oncall: Current status: service degraded -> mitigated. Queue falling to normal range. Will keep monitoring for 30m. Handing off to night oncall @matt_platform for continued observation and follow-ups.

matt_platform: taking handoff. Action items for follow-up:
  - Revert temporary exemptions and bring refill_rate to safe value after we complete token math.
  - Run scenario tests for autoscaler + rate-policy in staging.
  - Postmortem: timeline, why autoscaler calls were counted against hotpath bucket, and add automated alert if refill_rate < X% of expected autoscaler burst.

evan_oncall: Thanks team. Nice triage. Leaving logs & quicknotes in #incidents-runbook.

indra_sre: copying a quick mitigation stub for runbook: 
  - If autoscaler fails with token-bucket 429s: increase refill_rate OR exempt autoscaler client-id -> bump max_nodes -> create warm pool -> throttle non-SLA tier.

matt_platform: I'll keep an eye overnight and start the postmortem doc first thing. Handing off to @matt_platform :arrow_right: oncall.

incident-bot: Incident state changed to MITIGATED by evan_oncall at 2026-03-15T04:28Z.

matt_platform: (handoff ack)  — leaving this open until warm-pool fully drained of backlog and metrics stabilized.

maya_cs: closing loop with customers when final postmortem ready.

—— end thread —–
